Sprint plan

Sprint 1 discovers, plans and designs. Sprint 2 builds, tests and delivers.

Sprint 1

Nov 2 to Nov 6
  1. Mon, Nov 2Problem definition
  2. Tue, Nov 3Agile team charter and communication plan
  3. Wed, Nov 4Competitor analysis and user research
  4. Thu, Nov 5Feasibility and risk analysis
  5. Fri, Nov 6Wireframes and database design

Sprint 2

Nov 9 to Nov 13
  1. Mon, Nov 9Submit a comment and detect mood
  2. Tue, Nov 10Mixed comments and history
  3. Wed, Nov 11Mood chart and filter
  4. Thu, Nov 12Delete, clear and export
  5. Fri, Nov 13Testing, fixes and final demo
